content.text:
Edit instruction: Increase the bellows outer radius from 22.9 to 30.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

  "confidence": 0.95,
  "reason": "The edited part clearly shows a wider outer diameter for the bellows segments, particularly visible in the bottom-most segment in the top view and the front-most segment in the isometric view, consistent with increasing the radius."
